description: Countries, US states, US counties or congressional districts ranked by one indicator from Mappit's Map Apps data, for the latest or a given period, optionally within a country, a US state or a continent. Each value carries its period; the answer names the source and licence. Indicator codes come from list_map_apps; a news topic share is "news_topic_share:<topic>" (or pass topic).

indicator.description: An indicator code from list_map_apps, e.g. "unemployment_rate" or "news_topic_share:crime-safety".

level.description: One of: country, state, county, cd119, cd120 (congressional districts on the 2024 and 2026 lines).

period.description: A period like "2024", "2026-08" or "2026-08-15". Default: the latest.

topic.description: For news_topic_share only: the topic slug from list_map_apps ("crime-safety"), when indicator does not carry it.

within.description: Optional scope: a country ("United States"), a US state (for counties or districts) or a continent ("Africa").

name: rank_regions
title: Rank regions
